Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a fundamental error in interpreting the term "Prince Napoléon Bonaparte." In historical context, the title "Prince Napoléon" almost exclusively refers to Napoléon Eugène Louis Bonaparte (the Prince Imperial), who was the son of Napoleon III. The Planner incorrectly assumed the query referred to Napoleon I (Napoleon Bonaparte), whose father was Carlo Buonaparte. This misinterpretation led the entire conversation down the wrong path, searching for Carlo Buonaparte's birth date instead of Napoleon III's birth date (which is the father of the Prince Imperial). The correct answer to the user's question is April 20, 1808 (Napoleon III's birthday), not March 29, 1746.
